description: This Java source file defines the class KeyboardViewContainerView, a custom ViewGroup for managing keyboard views, candidate views, and action strips in an Android soft keyboard application. It handles layout, theming, touch interception, and dynamic addition/removal of action views.

classes.name: KeyboardViewContainerView
classes.description: A custom ViewGroup managing keyboard, candidate, and action strip views in an Android soft keyboard app.

classes.name: ClicksExtraDraw
classes.description: An inner class implementing ExtraDraw to visualize click points and their translations for debugging purposes.

methods.name: constructorInit
methods.description: Initializes the view, setting up click visualization if enabled.

methods.name: onViewAdded
methods.description: Handles logic when a child view is added, including setting listeners and theme.

methods.name: onViewRemoved
methods.description: Handles cleanup when a child view is removed.

methods.name: onInterceptTouchEvent
methods.description: Intercepts touch events for debugging visualization and offsetting touch coordinates.

methods.name: setActionsStripVisibility
methods.description: Controls visibility of the action strip and candidate view based on requested visibility.

methods.name: addStripAction
methods.description: Adds an action view to the action strip with optional high priority placement.

methods.name: removeStripAction
methods.description: Removes an action view associated with a provider from the action strip.

methods.name: onLayout
methods.description: Positions child views within the container, including layout of action views and main keyboard.

methods.name: onMeasure
methods.description: Measures child views to determine container size.

methods.name: setThemeForChildView
methods.description: Applies theme and overlay to a child view if it supports theming.

methods.name: setOnKeyboardActionListener
methods.description: Sets a listener for keyboard actions and propagates to child views.

methods.name: setKeyboardTheme
methods.description: Applies a theme to all child views.

methods.name: setThemeOverlay
methods.description: Sets a theme overlay for all child views.

methods.name: setBottomPadding
methods.description: Sets bottom padding and updates child views accordingly.
